**Verification output:**
- `bash -n scripts/prune-agents.sh` → clean (run twice, including after fix).
- Real dry-run in worktree: `free 22.0G, threshold 10G → above threshold, nothing to do`, exit 0.
- Forced-plan dry-run (`--min-free-gb 99999 --no-tmp --worktrees-root /nonexistent-root-xyz`): handles missing root gracefully, plans 0 dirs, deletes nothing, exit 0.
- Fixture `--apply` simulation (temp git repos under `/tmp/prune-fixture-*/wt-root`, forced with `--min-free-gb 99999 --no-repo-target --no-tmp`): dry-run planned oldest-first (`label-old` mtime 2020 before `label-new` 2024), skipped dirty and current-branch trees with reasons; `--apply` removed exactly the 2 clean non-current `target/` dirs, preserved all 4 `main.rs` sources and the dirty marker, left dirty/current targets intact. Fixture cleaned up.

**Safety argument (why it cannot delete source):**
- Default is dry-run; every `rm -rf` is behind `--apply`.
- Deletion candidates are only paths ending in `/target` enumerated by `find <root> -maxdepth 3 -name target` plus `./target` — never arbitrary source paths.
- `validate_target_path` re-checked before each `rm`: rejects non-`*/target` paths, `/`, `$HOME`, unresolvable parents, the current worktree, and anything outside `$WORKTREES_ROOT/*` or the repo root.
- Two independent skip guards, re-checked immediately before each deletion: (a) current tree by resolved path *and* by branch name (`agent/ops-prune` fixture tree was skipped); (b) `git -C <wt> status --porcelain` filtered to drop `target/` entries and untracked `dispatch*` lines — any remaining line means "uncommitted source changes" → skip (fixture dirty tree was skipped). Non-git dirs and `git status` failures also skip.
- Temp deletions restricted to an allowlist (`/tmp/inkuno-*`, `dispatch-*.log` older than 7d) with a current-worktree exclusion; `--no-tmp`/`--no-repo-target` knobs let tests avoid real paths entirely. Real `--apply` was never run against real worktrees.
- One bug found and fixed during fixture testing: on macOS `/tmp` → `/private/tmp` symlink made containment checks fail closed (refused deletion); fix canonicalizes `WORKTREES_ROOT` via `pwd -P` at startup.

**Open questions:**
- "Untracked dispatch logs" exclusion is implemented as untracked (`??`) paths matching `*dispatch*` (case-insensitive). If real dispatch logs use a different naming pattern, the filter may need widening — check one real filename.
- Stale `dispatch-*.log` lookup uses `-maxdepth 4` under the worktrees root and repo root with `-mtime +7`; adjust depth/age if logs live elsewhere.
- Worth confirming the blessed worktrees root (`~/.hoocode/worktrees`) is correct on Linux agents too, or whether `PRUNE_WORKTREES_ROOT` needs a per-host default.
